INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked. Please contact support.
ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your phone number to finish signing up.
PHONE_TAKEN: An account with this phone number already exists.
EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Please request a new one.
OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong attempts. Please request a new code.
OTP_COOLDOWN: Please wait {seconds} seconds before requesting another code.
RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
SESSION_NOT_FOUND: That device is no longer signed in.
ADMIN_EMAIL_TAKEN: An admin with this email already exists.
BOOKING_STATUS_INVALID: This booking can't be moved to that status from its current one.
BOOKING_STATUS_CHANGED: Someone else just changed this booking. Reload it and try again.
DISPUTE_ALREADY_RESOLVED: This dispute was already resolved the other way. Reload it to see the decision.
TAXONOMY_SLUG_TAKEN: Another item in this list already uses that slug.
TAXONOMY_KIND_MISMATCH: An item cannot be moved to another list.
TAXONOMY_LIMIT_REACHED: This list is full ({max} items). Delete one before adding another.
PROMOTION_KIND_SLOT_MISMATCH: This slot takes a different kind of promotion: only the home campaign slot takes campaigns.
PROMOTION_LINK_NOT_FOUND: The business, site or category to link to does not exist.
PROMOTION_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: A promotion can only link to an approved business or a published heritage site.
FEATURED_SLOT_DISABLED: This slot is switched off. Turn on featuring and this slot in Settings first.
FEATURED_SLOT_AT_CAPACITY: This slot is full ({capacity} at a time). End or delete a promotion in it first.
COUPON_CODE_TAKEN: Another discount code already uses that code.
COUPON_CODE_LOCKED: This code has already been used in bookings, so its code can no longer change. Switch it off and add a new one instead.
COUPON_SCOPE_INVALID: The scope does not fit what it points at: a platform code points at nothing, a category code needs one of the five categories, and the other scopes need an id.
COUPON_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: The business this code is for does not exist.
